evidence: Carries the P2P label and modifies connection management, NAT-PMP, and Tor controller lifecycle in src/net.cpp and src/torcontrol.cpp.
rationale: Prevents background NAT-PMP port mapping queries and Tor control port connection attempts when network activity is toggled off. When `-networkactive=0` is set, background components continued running and logging retry attempts despite the node being inactive (issue #34190).
